deploy-bot: Planned rollout scheduled for NorthStar Inc. (Dedicated) on 2026-04-02 02:00 UTC. Job: rb-deploy-9876. Proposed model version: northstar/llama-2-70b-quant-v1.3.4-rc2. Canary: 5% traffic for 30m. Rollout: 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 2h. Rollback thresholds: latency p95 +30% or error rate >2.5%.

Anna (eng-release): pls pin model version to rc2 for this customer? we had a tokenization mismatch earlier.

Jared (eng-platform): we should pin runtime to kernel-v3.8 + q8 profile. if not, client may see mismatch.

Cynthia (sre): SRE/oncall signoff needed: need fallback route to hosted smaller model (gpt-slim-13b) and an immediate circuit-breaker. Suggest thresholds: 5xx > 1% for 5m or p95 > 500ms.

Liz (customer-ops): NorthStar confirmed maintenance window 02:00-06:00 UTC and wants minimal impact. They've signed off on canary. I'll notify their ops lead.

Ravi (product): release notes drafted: https://redwood.internal/docs/releases/northstar-2026-04-02. Also include hallucination regression test set. QA green required before canary.

Anna (eng-release): QA pass complete. Snapshot: `evals/rollout/northstar/2026-03-28/results.json` — all critical prompts OK.

Jared (eng-platform): Deploy-bot can you pin to version and hold for manual trigger? `deploybot pin rb-deploy-9876 --version northstar/llama-2-70b-quant@v1.3.4-rc2 --hold`

deploy-bot: Pinned job rb-deploy-9876 to northstar/llama-2-70b-quant@v1.3.4-rc2 and set hold. Runbook: /runbooks/northstar-dedicated-rollout.md

Cynthia (sre): Added rollback playbook. Oncall will watch dashboards. Watchlist: /dashboards/northstar/rollout. Alert thresholds updated.

Liz (customer-ops): I'll send release notes + timeline to NorthStar ops. Please confirm final go/no-go 1h before window.

Anna (eng-release): OK — go/no-go at 01:00 UTC on 2026-04-02. If no objections by then I'll trigger canary.

Jared (eng-platform): +1. Also ensure KV-cache warm job runs pre-cutover: `kubectl exec -c warm --warm-cache northstar-warm-0 --file /warm/prompt_list.txt`.

Ravi (product): quant baseline shows 0.4% BLEU delta — acceptable. QA flagged no regression on key prompts.

Cynthia (sre): Final alerting rules: pause if error rate >1% for 10m during canary, immediate rollback if 5xx >5% or CPU >90% on any node for 5m. Notify #oncall.

Anna (eng-release): locking plan. thanks all. :thumbsup:
